title: Riesz uniqueness turns the C_c dilation law into μ(s·A) = sⁿ μ(A) for every set A
statement: Let μ be a Borel measure on ℝ^N that is finite on compact sets, n ∈ ℕ and s > 0. Suppose that ∫ g(s⁻¹y) dμ(y) = s^n ∫ g dμ for every continuous function g : ℝ^N → ℝ with compact support. Then μ(s·A) = s^n μ(A) for every set A ⊆ ℝ^N (not necessarily measurable); in ℝ≥0∞: μ (s • A) = ENNReal.ofReal s ^ n * μ A.
lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclidean N)) (s : ℝ), IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ → 0 < s → (∀ g : Euclidean N → ℝ, Continuous g → HasCompactSupport g → ∫ y, g (s⁻¹ • y) ∂μ = s ^ n * ∫ y, g y ∂μ) → ∀ A : Set (Euclidean N), μ (s • A) = ENNReal.ofReal s ^ n * μ A
